about: The one place a form may differ from a node (reviews/form-parity.md, ADR-072): tools/forms_check.py runs tests/forms/*.slt on every form and fails on any difference these lists don't name.

forms.cluster: three nodes on one lake, each query spread over them
forms.inprocess: a node in the caller's process, through the library (Python's and JavaScript's connect(path))
forms.memory: a node in the caller's process on a lake in memory (connect() with no path, DuckDB's :memory:)
forms.page: the browser's form (web/pkg's Page), one thread and no lake

refusals.why: P2: DataFusion's INSERT takes no DEFAULT in VALUES; the column's default belongs in the core's write rules (rules::shape), as a node fills it

refusals.says: a page makes no types yet \(CREATE TYPE\)
refusals.why: P4: a node keeps its types in its catalog (types.rs); a page keeps none, so its host has no enum labels to give the front

refusals.says: a page doesn't keep GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY
refusals.why: P1: a page has no counters yet, so its tables keep no identity; kept on a page by rc.1

refusals.says: a page doesn't take INSERT … ON CONFLICT yet
refusals.why: P1: a page keeps PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE and CHECK, and its INSERT only adds rows; upserts come with the core's write rules (rules::insert)

refusals.says: a page keeps no table's past
refusals.why: P9: a page keeps each table's latest version only, with no log to read an older one from

refusals.says: a page has no transactions yet \(BEGIN\)
refusals.why: A page runs each statement on its own (a node's transactions are txn.rs's): it refuses BEGIN, COMMIT, ROLLBACK and the savepoint words by name, so no caller goes on thinking a ROLLBACK undid its UPDATE

refusals.says: a page has no variables yet \(DECLARE\)
refusals.why: DECLARE $x is a node's step before its engine (vars.rs, server-only); a page refuses it by name

refusals.says: Inconsistent data length across values list
refusals.why: P2: a row narrower than its table takes the rest's defaults on a node (as in Postgres); DataFusion refuses it. The core's write rules (rules::shape)

refusals.says: a page doesn't take MERGE yet
refusals.why: DataFusion has no MERGE; a node's is write.rs's, which a page lacks until the core's write rules (form parity §3)
